summary: Responsive/cross-device testing (Windows desktop 1440x900 and iPhone-like mobile 390x844). Auth page, mobile nav drawer, Overview, Compliance Posture and Control Monitoring pages all pass on mobile. Desktop regression (sidebar/mode toggles) also passes. No horizontal overflow detected on any tested page/viewport. One notable mobile UX issue: AIAdvisor panel auto-opens on first login and, because it is w-full on mobile, covers the entire viewport including the hamburger button until the user finds the close (X) inside it.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (<sm, <640px) advisor-panel is w-full and it auto-opens on the first session after login (sessionStorage 'advisor-opened'). This completely blocks the app viewport including the mobile-nav-toggle (hamburger) until user manually taps advisor-close. First-time iOS users see the Advisor, not the dashboard/nav.
The mobile-nav-close (X) button is absolutely positioned at top-4 right-3 and visually overlaps the Obserra logo header inside the drawer (both occupy the top row). Minor visual polish.

action_items: Consider NOT auto-opening AIAdvisor on mobile viewport (or make the panel w-[90%] with a visible backdrop) so first-time mobile users can see the dashboard/hamburger without needing to close the advisor.
Reposition the mobile-nav-close X button (e.g. put it inside the sidebar header row) so it doesn't overlap the Obserra logo in the drawer.
critical_code_review_comments: AIAdvisor auto-open logic (AIAdvisor.jsx line 72) does not consider viewport size - forces panel open on 390px iPhone screen where panel is w-full and blocks all app interaction including the new mobile-nav-toggle.

AppShell.jsx NAV items (nav-* data-testids) are rendered twice on mobile (desktop <aside class='hidden md:flex'> is still in DOM). Tests must scope by mobile-nav-drawer or the desktop-hidden copy is matched first. Not a bug, just a test-authoring gotcha.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the requested responsive checklist; 1 medium + 1 low mobile UX finding

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 responsive test items in review_request pass. Verified: mobile auth (hero hidden lg:flex → display:none), mobile /app has hamburger + drawer with nav-overview / nav-compliance-posture / nav-cyber-risk (each testid appears twice in DOM because desktop sidebar is still mounted with class 'hidden md:flex' - scope clicks to '[data-testid=mobile-nav-drawer] [data-testid=nav-...]'). Drawer closes on: close button, backdrop click, and nav link click. header-advisor-input is hidden on mobile. Overview/Compliance/Controls have zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == 390). Desktop 1440: sidebar visible, hamburger hidden, mode-toggle-executive/operational both work. Only concern: AIAdvisor auto-opens on first session and, being w-full on mobile, blocks everything until user closes it — flagged as MEDIUM UX issue.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - no functional bugs. AIAdvisor mobile-obstruction RCA: sessionStorage-based auto-open in AIAdvisor.jsx L72 fires regardless of viewport, and panel classes are 'fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-full sm:w-[440px]' so on <640px it is full-width. Mitigation: skip auto-open when window.innerWidth < 640, or change to w-[92%] max-w-[440px] with a semi-transparent backdrop so users can still see/dismiss it easily.
